with BuildPart() as p:

            arc = ThreePointArc(l2 @ 1, (bracket_length/2, bracket_height + 5), (0, bracket_height))
            l3 = Line(arc @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=bracket_thickness)

            l1 = Line((0, 0), (rod_diameter/2, 0))

            l3 = Line(l2@1, (reduced_diameter/2, (rod_length - reduced_section_length)/2))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (reduced_diameter/2, (rod_length + reduced_section_length)/2))
            l5 = Line(l4@1, (rod_diameter/2, (rod_length + reduced_section_length)/2))

        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part

for x, y in [(-hole_spacing/2, 0), (hole_spacing/2, 0)]:
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, y, rod_length/2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, rod_length)

        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((inner_radius, 0), (inner_radius, thickness))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (outer_radius, thickness))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (outer_radius, 0))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (inner_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_distance)

solid_body = solid_body + Pos(0, 0, boss_height/2) * Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_height)

        with BuildLine() as rib_bl:
            rl1 = Line((rib_inner_radius, 0), (rib_inner_radius, rib_height))
